answer: Use peer-prediction scoring: every agent grades other agents' outputs, and each grade is checked against a random panel of peers; graders are paid only when their scores statistically agree with the panel consensus, so lazy rubber-stamping or sybil self-grading rings lose money. A sybil attacker running fake grader identities like zephyr, ember, and pigment must make each one actually grade accurately to earn anything, which costs real work per identity; consensus fees per accurate grade exceed the rewards a fake identity can extract, so mass fake identities stay unprofitable.
